description: Check whether a web page's Meta Pixel (Facebook Pixel) works: cookie consent, duplicate events, event IDs, the ad click ID (fbclid -> _fbc) and signs of server-side tracking. A browser in the EU visits the page twice. Reuses a result from the last 24 hours unless recheck is true. Waits for the result up to wait_seconds (a check takes 20 to 60 seconds); if it is still running, call get_report later.

recheck.description: Start a fresh check instead of reusing a recent result (allowed once the last check is an hour old). Use after a fix was deployed.

url.description: The page to check, usually the landing page the ads point to, e.g. https://example.com/landing

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, 0 to 45 seconds (default 40).

name: check_page
title: Check a page's Meta Pixel
